scope: Development study of a combination: the smoothness continuation C2 followed by a long L-BFGS budget on the original problem (w = 1/2). Both the C2 runs and the paired v2 analytic baseline runs resume from their final checkpoints (equal prior budgets: 4,000 Adam updates and 800 L-BFGS calls) and receive the same 4,000 additional L-BFGS calls with a fresh L-BFGS history. Primary question: does the additional budget reach physical acceptance? Secondary question: does the C2 start reach it sooner than the baseline start? The secondary comparison is underpowered (two seeds; final stratified pressures of rounding-equivalent engines already differ by up to 32%), so differences below 32% are not interpreted. Seeds 361901/361902 were observed before; this is not a formal time-to-accuracy study.

physical.state_observer: native coordinate AD of the trained curl-potential network

baseline:361901.source: v2 development analytic run, final checkpoint

baseline:361902.source: v2 development analytic run, final checkpoint

C2:361901.source: v3 smoothness run C2 (attempt 2), final checkpoint

C2:361902.source: v3 smoothness run C2 (attempt 2), final checkpoint

training.start: resume from the start checkpoint (sha256-verified θ); fresh L-BFGS history; counters (Adam updates, L-BFGS calls, closures) restart at zero, source counts are recorded separately
training.maximum_training_seconds_reason: worst case 4,000 calls x 25 evaluations x about 0.175 s = 17,500 s, plus 40 complete-gradient checks
training.stop_rule: none; the full budget runs unless the time guard fires
training.truncation: if maximum_training_seconds is reached the run stops before the next call, saves its final checkpoint at the cut, records budget_truncated and the calls reached; scheduled checkpoints that were not reached are absent and the observation plan skips them
training.training_gate: already met at the start checkpoint; recorded at the first resumed evaluation

qualification.original_problem_native: the original-problem engine is checked against the preserved native reference at the stored initial parameters of each seed (as v2/v3)
qualification.resume_point: dense parameter AD at the start parameters, after a parameter change and after garbage collection and allocator churn (stage0-entry/changed/retained)
qualification.continuity: the loss evaluated at the start parameters must match the source run final_loss within the original budget (atol + rtol |b|)
qualification.scheduled: complete loss/gradient/numerator check against dense parameter AD every 100 L-BFGS calls and at the end

physical_observation.observer: unchanged box376.potential_physical, chunk chosen by the calibration rule of the earlier batches (fastest chunk agreeing with chunk 128 to 1e-10 of the maximum state magnitude within 60 GB), independent reader box376.audit_potential_run
physical_observation.call_0: the start checkpoints are already observed (baseline finals at chunk 128 in observation batch 1, C2 finals at chunk 512 in observation batch 3)

decision_rule.implementation: box376.decide_c36_v4 (pre-registered with this protocol; standard library only)
decision_rule.acceptance: a checkpoint passes when the unchanged observer reports physical_acceptance_pass
decision_rule.first_pass: per run, the smallest observed extra-call count in (800, 1600, 2400, 3200, final) whose checkpoint passes; none if no observed checkpoint passes; resolution is limited to these points
decision_rule.count: L-BFGS calls and evaluations from the resume point; seconds are secondary
decision_rule.stopped_falling: for an arm, stratified corrected pressure at final >= 0.95 x its value at LBFGS-call3200 on both seeds

outcomes_in_order.O1_both_arms_pass: all four runs have a first pass; sub-result C2_sooner if C2 first_pass < baseline first_pass on both seeds, baseline_sooner if the reverse holds on both seeds, otherwise same_or_mixed
outcomes_in_order.O2_only_C2_passes: both C2 runs pass and at least one baseline run does not
outcomes_in_order.O3_only_baseline_passes: both baseline runs pass and at least one C2 run does not
outcomes_in_order.O4_partial: some run passes but none of O1-O3 holds
outcomes_in_order.O5_none_still_falling: no run passes and neither arm has stopped falling
outcomes_in_order.O6_none_stopped: no run passes and at least one arm has stopped falling

decision_rule.secondary: stratified pressure and velocity at matched extra-call counts and first threshold evaluations; C2-versus-baseline differences below 32% are not interpreted
decision_rule.follow_up: if any arm passes on both seeds, freeze a formal protocol with new seeds (fresh runs with the full schedule, both engines) for time to accepted accuracy; otherwise no formal claim

execution.allocation: one new ACC node, four H100 lanes, one (seed, start) per lane; training only, followed by a separate all-planes observation batch
execution.walltime_reason: the worst-case training time (about 5.1 h) exceeds the default 3 h test window; the remainder covers compilation, the reader and the archive
